youtube.baslik: Why can't you hear people talking when you are underwater? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: When sound passes from air into fluid, most of its energy reflects back; only about one thousandth enters the fluid. Since the inner ear is filled with fluid, without the middle ear we would lose about 30 dB.
